Method of Attack: Using the -DownloadFile argument to download arbitrary files including malware onto a system
Abuse as a living-off-the-land binary (LOLBIN) to bypass security detections
Attack Vector: Command-line utility abuse via MpCmdRun.exe -DownloadFile argument
Indicators of Compromise: Error message 'CmdTool: Invalid command line argument' after removal of -DownloadFile option
